tweets.text: .@SecMayorkas conducted an extensive review to assess whether MPP should be maintained, terminated, or modified.
tweets.text_resolved: .@SecMayorkas conducted an extensive review to assess whether MPP should be maintained, terminated, or modified.

tweets.text: .@SecMayorkas studied court documents, relevant data, internal reviews, and publicly available materials, and met with a broad and diverse array of internal and external stakeholders, including DHS personnel, state and local officials, and community leaders across the country.
tweets.text_resolved: .@SecMayorkas studied court documents, relevant data, internal reviews, and publicly available materials, and met with a broad and diverse array of internal and external stakeholders, including DHS personnel, state and local officials, and community leaders across the country.

tweets.text: .@SecMayorkas concluded that the benefits do not justify the costs, particularly given the way in which MPP detracts from other regional and domestic goals and policy initiatives that better align with this Administration’s values.
tweets.text_resolved: .@SecMayorkas concluded that the benefits do not justify the costs, particularly given the way in which MPP detracts from other regional and domestic goals and policy initiatives that better align with this Administration’s values.

tweets.text: MPP also distracts from regional efforts to address root causes, focusing resources and attention on this singular program rather than on the work that is needed to implement broader and more enduring solutions.
tweets.text_resolved: MPP also distracts from regional efforts to address root causes, focusing resources and attention on this singular program rather than on the work that is needed to implement broader and more enduring solutions.
